reviewer: Kimi independent actual visual comparison of the exact native source, enlarged source page 06 and targeted source-note crops, complete unchanged native RGBA raw, targeted native-resolution returned-note crop, full white/cyan/alpha sheet and unchanged naiwa mascot reference

remaining_reasons: The enlarged source note clearly has two compact upper rows of faint gray marks, while the native-resolution return has three distinct rows, including an added third lower-left row. Remove the invented extra row and restore only the source's two-row upper footprint, keeping the lower paper largely blank.
entries.positive_observation: The high receding hairline, very short dark-brown crown/side hair and dark eyebrows are represented without adding headgear or glasses. The face has one closed mouth, a smooth chin and no visible moustache or beard. The nearly frontal slightly left-facing pose and chest-up crop remain. The dark olive uniform retains two red collar patches with gold details, gold-toned viewer-left shoulder trim, one pale blue-white ribbon and one prominent silver-toned cross-shaped neck pendant. The rounded chin meets a short broad collar without a long stalk or clipping. The complete tilted dark frame, opaque gray-olive photographic backing, warm-cream note and small right-edge tab remain. Full white/cyan comparisons show no visible interior holes, lost backing or working-matte outer ring; the added note row is the separate rejection reason above.
entries.visible_limitations: Exact collar/pendant symbols and the finest hairline pixels are not readable at 65x67, and the note glyphs are not readable text. Those uncertainties are not rejection reasons; the source crop clearly resolves two upper rows versus three in the return.
